source_spec.generator_command: ultragoal product success contract static example generation

job_to_be_done: Fit a repository without letting unsupported proof become completion claims
context_of_use: Codex local repo setup or retrofit session
desired_user_outcome: The agent receives clear gates and cannot claim unsupported product success
business_or_mission_outcome: Reduce false completion and product-proof theater in high-stakes repo work
first_value_event: validator rejects a product success substitution red fixture
accessibility_gate: product proof language and receipts are text-first and screen-reader inspectable
cognitive_load_gate: entry routing starts from fit-repo and names exact missing evidence
recovery_burden_gate: unsupported claims are withheld with repair class and evidence requirements
trust_burden_gate: same-surface receipts and non-E2E ceiling prevent proof substitution
human_attention_policy: ask for human judgment only after deterministic proof path is exhausted or judgment-only review is explicitly required
